criteria.name: Mission concept and rationale — What will it do, who are the users, why is it needed?
criteria.reasoning: The submission provides an exemplary mission concept specifically addressing Great Barrier Reef coral bleaching. It clearly delineates goals, quantified objectives, requirements, and user agencies (AIMS, GBRMPA, CSIRO, BoM) mapped to operational needs, fully supported by relevant citations.

evidence.quote: Give reef managers direct, repeatable observations of coral colour over the whole Great Barrier Reef, so that bleaching is detected within days
The satellite would be operated by the Australian Institute of Marine Science (AIMS). Its customers are the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Authority

criteria.name: Project plan — How you plan to complete the assignment, including either a Gantt chart or a timetable and information sources you plan to use
criteria.reasoning: The project plan includes a well-structured Gantt chart, task breakdown, software selection with remote access details, explicitly planned information sources, and an excellent contingency risk matrix tied to technical trade-offs.

criteria.name: Preliminary progress — Technical content and evidence of sufficient work done to date
criteria.reasoning: Substantial preliminary engineering work is presented. The student performed hand calculations for a 600 km SSO, cross-checked the orbital period in STK, and critically analyzed ground track shift versus sensor swath against reef geometry.

evidence.quote: Table 3: Preliminary hand calculations for the candidate orbit.
Interpretation: the reef is up to about 250 km wide, so a 60 km swath needs at least five neighbouring passes

criteria.name: Report presentation
criteria.reasoning: The report is impeccably structured, professional, concise, and easy to read. Figures and tables are properly titled and captioned, and standard IEEE reference formats are used correctly throughout.

overall: Outstanding preliminary report. The mission concept is well reasoned and backed by literature, the project plan includes robust risk contingencies, and the preliminary orbit calculations demonstrate sound technical progress.

feedback.summary: You delivered an outstanding preliminary report that achieved full marks across all rubric criteria. Your mission concept for coral bleaching monitoring is exceptionally well-justified and linked to end users. Furthermore, your project planning includes thorough risk mitigations, your preliminary orbital analysis shows robust engineering progress, and the presentation is professional and meticulously referenced.
next_steps: Translate your candidate 600 km SSO orbit into complete STK mission simulations to model full reef revisit and coverage times.
Advance your preliminary payload analysis by sizing sensor optics and data downlinks to match the identified swath and resolution needs.
Maintain this high standard of technical rigour, professional layout, and thorough literature referencing as you draft the final report.

criteria.C1: You achieved the Accomplished level by clearly establishing mission goals, quantified objectives, and traceable requirements linked directly to key stakeholders (AIMS, GBRMPA, CSIRO, BoM) in the 'Mission Concept & Rationale' section. To maintain this high standard, continue referencing literature to justify any operational mission adjustments.
criteria.C2: Your project plan reached the Accomplished tier through a robust Gantt chart, explicit software plans, and an excellent risk and contingency matrix (Table 1) tied to technical trade-offs. To sustain this, continue documenting how schedule adaptations and contingencies are executed as technical complexities evolve.
criteria.C3: You met the Accomplished standard by providing rigorous preliminary engineering work in Table 3, combining hand calculations with STK cross-validation and interpreting sensor swath against reef geometry. To build on this in future submissions, integrate these preliminary orbital parameters into comprehensive mission lifetime and coverage simulations.
criteria.C4: You attained the Accomplished level with an impeccably structured, easy-to-read report featuring professional formatting, well-captioned figures and tables (such as Figure 1), and accurate IEEE citations. To sustain this grade, maintain consistent referencing and professional document design across all forthcoming project deliverables.
